title: Kick-off - Lovers x HotWax Commerce
summary: HotWax Commerce and Lovers reviewed implementation scope, priorities, testing, and launch planning. HotWax had internally reviewed the P0 and P1 customizations, with P0 completion targeted for the current week and testing handoff planned for early the following week. The integration will import only BOPIS and DoorDash orders from Shopify into HotWax, using existing Shopify tags and sales-channel identifiers. P0 requirements include displaying both order types on one screen; showing product name, size, color, and SKU; providing customer receipts; supporting extended or non-expiring store sessions; and enabling whole-order DoorDash cancellations synchronized with Shopify. P1 requirements include prioritizing DoorDash orders, tracking associate fulfillment activity, and synchronizing cancellations and refunds between HotWax and Shopify. BOPIS orders may be partially fulfilled, while DoorDash cancellations are all-or-nothing and may originate in HotWax, DoorDash, or Shopify. DoorDash does not require a direct agreement with HotWax because order access will occur through Shopify. Receipt design remains open pending final printer specifications.
